why: Nine public experimental forecasts are frozen for 2026-08-13, but the earliest kickoff is 23:00Z — no result exists yet. The settlement path is PROVEN on a scratch fixture (3 synthetic finals graded, exactly-once verified on rerun, market benchmark computed in its own lane) and the real run correctly reports 9 pending. A post-event artifact must never masquerade as pre-event evidence, so this waits for reality.

trigger.condition: the sport-schedules cadence lands the Aug 13 finals in app/public/data/nfl/results/latest.json with STATUS_FINAL and integer scores

acceptance: each of the nine forecasts settles EXACTLY ONCE; a second run adds zero rows
the graded receipt is the LATEST PRE-KICKOFF revision — the forecast readers actually saw — with the full revision chain preserved as lineage
accounting reconciles with gap zero (receipts = settled + pending + quarantined) or the script refuses to write
metrics are distribution metrics only — winner correctness, margin/total MAE, 80% interval coverage, Brier, log loss — and no W-L, ROI, stake, or exposure field exists
the market benchmark is computed in its own block and never merged into the model's metrics
protected money stays byte-identical: portfolio affe6b21..., locks cb80473f...
knownRisks: a tie (preseason ties are real) has no winner side and is excluded from the decisive denominator, not counted as a loss
a FINAL without integer scores quarantines rather than grading
a correction after settlement appends lineage; the original receipt and prior result version are preserved
